context.passage:
Welcome!
The Southern Cultural League is proud to present our first annual storytelling
event, hosted by the Sydney Public Library. Cassie Gates, our director, has
booked four speakers who are sure to inspire you with innovative ways to
incorporate storytelling into your lives and classrooms.
Storytelling Event Schedule
8:00-9:45 A.M. Introduction: The Power of Story
Local storyteller Rarriwuy Henry sets a shining example as she spins a
delightful tale that demonstrates how we, as storytellers, can spread the joy
of this ancient tradition.
10:00-11:45 A.M. Collecting and Sharing Family Stories
Family stories we all have them, but how do we tell them? Liam Murphy, a
storyteller from Melbourne, shares tips for turning precious memories into
tales that can be passed down through generations.
1:00-2:45 P.M. Verse and Versatility
There's something about rhythm and rhyme that touches our souls and stays
in our minds. Poet Janna Cibson explains how we can incorporate elements
of verse into our stories to make them more memorable.
3:00-4:45 P.M. From Books to Oral Tales
Maybe you write books. Maybe you read them. But how do we make the
stories within them come alive to a listening audience? Author Ann Sparks
shares her secrets for telling written stories in captivating ways.
